## Undergraduate research

Inquiries about undergraduate research positions are welcome. If you're interested in fieldwork at Konza, working with ecological data, or developing an independent study, email Zak Ratajczak. Tell me a little about yourself and what you'd like to try. You don't need previous research experience to get in touch.

## Graduate students

I welcome inquiries from prospective graduate students.
